title: Juicy Chinese Pork Lettuce Wrap
description: A bitter and juicy hunan-style dish featuring twice-cooked pork wrapped in iceberg lettuce leaves. Egg-free-friendly.

ingredients.name: twice-cooked pork
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of ground meat and fat for juiciness

instructions: Prepare the pork by mixing with salt, sugar, vinegar, and soy sauce. Let it marinate for at least an hour.
Heat peanut oil in a pan over medium heat. Add marinated pork and cook until fully cooked, about 15 minutes.
Wash and cut iceberg lettuce leaves to size for the wraps.
Divide twice-cooked pork into equal portions and stuff each lettuce leaf with meat.
Serve hot as a light lunch dish.
Optional garnish: add crushed red pepper flakes or scallions on top of the wraps.
